description: Portable YAGNI ladder and concise execution preset (host-agnostic equivalent of legacy ponytail mode).

overrides.content:
## Concise / YAGNI discipline (preset: yagni-concise)

Prefer the smallest verified change that satisfies the stated contract:
reuse existing abstractions > stdlib > installed dependencies > minimal new code.
Avoid speculative generality, unnecessary wrappers and unrelated edits.
